title: Breece Hall ‘more hungry’ to prove himself after landing $43.5 million Jets deal

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Breece Hall ‘more hungry’ to prove himself after landing $43.5 million Jets deal
sources.description: It’s one thing to prove you were worth a second-round pick, it’s a whole new ball game trying to prove you’re worth a long-term contract as a 25-year-old running back.
